project_name: Catering & Small Business Pre-Accounting SaaS (Ön Muhasebe Admin Panel)

layout_strategy.structure: Collapsible Left Sidebar + Sticky Topbar + Dynamic Breadcrumbs + Main Content Grid

pages_breakdown.description: Multi-tenant login view with email, password, remember me, language toggle, and tenant context visual indicator for Ecrin Yemek.
6-digit OTP verification card with countdown timer, backup code fallback, and QR code setup modal.
Financial KPIs (Gelir, Gider, Net Kar, Bekleyen Siparişler), Cash Flow Recharts AreaChart, Recent Invoices Table, Daily Catering Delivery Schedule, Quick Action Buttons.
Company profile form (Ecrin Yemek Catering A.Ş.), Tax Office/No (Vergi Dairesi/No), Logo Uploader, Invoice Defaults, Currency (TRY/EUR/USD), Address & Contact.
Data Table with User search, Role badge, Status toggle, Mobile phone for field staff, 'Yeni Kullanıcı Davet Et' Modal, Edit/Delete dialogs.
RBAC Matrix UI (Admin, Muhasebeci, Operasyon, Saha Teslimat, Izleyici) with checkable granular permission rules per module.
Feature Toggles grid for SaaS modules (Ön Muhasebe, Menü Planlama, Saha Yoklama, E-Fatura Entegrasyonu, Stok Takibi) with status indicators.
Grid & List views for PDF Invoices, Delivery Slips (İrsaliye), Contracts, and Hygiene Certificates with file upload dropzone and filter tags.
Enforce MFA for organization switch, active login sessions table with IP/device info, revocation buttons, and password policy settings.
High-density timeline table of system actions with date filter, event severity badges (Info, Warning, Critical), actor user, IP address, and JSON payload diff drawer.
SaaS Platform Management UI listing all tenants (Ecrin Yemek, Lezzet Catering, etc.), creation wizard, subscription status (Basic/Pro/Enterprise), MRR contribution, suspend/activate controls.
Server health metrics (FastAPI response latency, MySQL DB connections, worker jobs queue, storage utilization, active tenant metrics).

component_guidelines.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/*.js (Button, Input, Card, Dialog, Select, Table, Badge, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Switch, Tooltip, Sheet).
component_guidelines.tables: Use dense layout, subtle hover states, sticky headers, multi-select checkboxes, pagination controls, and status badges.
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts (ResponsiveContainer, AreaChart, BarChart, PieChart) with custom tooltips, formatted TRY (₺) currency values, and smooth animations.
component_guidelines.modals: Always build accessible dialogs with clear 'Vazgeç / Cancel' and 'Kaydet / Save' buttons.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use 'sonner' toast library for action notifications (e.g. 'Fatura başarıyla kaydedildi', 'Kullanıcı rolü güncellendi').

i18n_requirement.implementation: Language state stored in context/React state with full dictionary coverage across all 12 screens so toggling instantly translates sidebars, buttons, tables, badges, and titles.

test_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, forms, buttons, table rows, tab triggers, language selectors, and modals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create or update React views in frontend/src/ corresponding to all 12 key pages.
Ensure dual language (TR / EN) switcher works flawlessly across all pages.
Implement Ecrin Yemek catering branding and multi-tenant switcher seamlessly.
Ensure mobile responsiveness for field delivery staff on phone screens.
Add data-testid to every clickable element and form field.
